title: Ronaldo becomes first player to score at six World Cups as Portugal thrash Uzbekistan
byline: Cristiano Ronaldo wrote himself into the World Cup record books as Portugal thrashed Uzbekistan 5-0 in Houston.

title: Athapaththu Century Powers Sri Lanka Past Ireland
byline: Sri Lanka kept their Women’s T20 World Cup semi-final hopes alive with a dominant nine-wicket victory over Ireland, powered by a sensational unbeaten century from captain Chamari Athapaththu.

title: Ministry mulls penalties for school canteens flouting healthy food guidelines
byline: The Ministry of Health is considering imposing penalties on school canteens that fail to comply with newly introduced healthy food guidelines aimed at promoting safe and nutritious eating habits among students, Daily Mirror learns.

title: Sri Lanka promises to make payment clearance as soon as feasible
byline: The recent US $2.5 million cyber theft from the newly established Public Debt Management Office (PDMO)—where a sovereign debt repayment to Australia was intercepted via systemic digital breaches, had a direct bearing on Sri Lanka’s programme with the International Monetary Fund (IMF), according to a top official.

title: Pope’s intervention sought by relatives of Sallay
byline: An appeal has been made to His Holiness Pope Leo XIV seeking humanitarian intervention regarding the detention of former State Intelligence Service (SIS) Director Major General (Retd.) Suresh Sallay, who is currently being held under the custody of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID).

title: Spa therapists’ identities revealed after arrests
byline: The Lanka Spa Association and International Human Rights Law Association have lodged separate complaints with the Human Rights Commission of Sri Lanka, alleging that the rights and privacy of a group of spa therapists arrested during a recent police operation were violated after videos recorded at a police station were released and circulated publicly.

title: Sallay walking around, dressing himself
byline: The Government has denied allegations regarding the ill-treatment and torture of former State Intelligence Service (SIS) Director Suresh Sallay while under the custody of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID).

title: Amended National Environmental Act to be presented to Parliament today
byline: The long-awaited bill to amend Sri Lanka’s National Environmental Act (NEA) is scheduled to be presented for its final reading, debate, and vote in Parliament today, marking a significant milestone in the country’s environmental governance framework.

title: Canadian student nabbed with Rs. 350 mn hashish at BIA
byline: A Canadian nursing student was arrested at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), Katunayake, for allegedly attempting to smuggle hashish worth an estimated Rs. 350 million into Sri Lanka, Customs officials said.

title: US Senate votes to pass Iran war powers resolution in blow to Trump
byline: The United States Senate has passed a resolution calling for President Donald Trump to either halt his military campaign against Iran or seek congressional approval before any further action is taken.

title: Reported earlier by Daily Mirror
byline: As Daily Mirror reported on May 5, 2026 (under the ’title Sri Lanka’s new VAT rules could have negative outcome on tourism, telecom, IT sectors’ written by Panduka Keerthinanda), government Gazette amendments expanding VAT coverage to the digital economy had already triggered concern across multiple sectors, including telecommunications, tourism, and information technology.

title: Govt. retains Rs. 60 Mn VAT threshold, drops planned reduction
byline: The government has decided to retain the current Rs. 60 million annual turnover threshold for Value Added Tax (VAT) and the Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL), postponing a previously proposed reduction to Rs. 36 million that was scheduled to take effect from July 1.

title: Main suspects arrested in Jaffna over female physiotherapist’s body found in car
byline: Police have arrested the main suspect in the case involving the discovery of a woman’s body inside a parked car in the Teldeniya area, along with his wife and a young child, during a joint operation in Jaffna.

title: Police officers involved in Deraniyagala clash will be penalised if found guilty: Minister
byline: Police officers who were involved in the clash in Deraniyagala recently will be penalised if found guilty, Minister of Public Security Ananda Wijepala told Parliament today.

title: National Environment Amendment Bill unconditional: Opposition
byline: The Opposition in Parliament today argued that the National Environment Amendment Bill is unconditional as it violates the 13th Amendment.

title: Extreme heat forces school closures across Britain
byline: Hundreds of schools across Britain have been forced to close or send pupils home early as the country braces for a rare red extreme heat warning, with temperatures expected to soar to a record 40°C.

title: No decision to increase paddy purchasing price by PMB
byline: The government is likely to focus on increasing concessions given to paddy farmers rather than increasing the purchase price of paddy by the Paddy Marketing Board (PMB), Minister of Agriculture K.D. Lal Kantha told Parliament today.

title: 24-hour water cut in several areas from tonight
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced a 24-hour water cut in several areas, including Padukka, Homagama, Kottawa, Pannipitiya and Pelenwatte, from tonight.

title: Dengue nears 50,000 cases as islandwide control drive begins
byline: Sri Lanka has launched a three-day islandwide dengue control programme today (24) as health authorities race to contain the rapid spread of the disease, which has infected close to 50,000 people and claimed 28 lives so far this year.

title: RONALDO MAKES HISTORY: First Player to Score in Six World Cups
byline: Ronaldo makes history with a new World Cup scoring record, Donald Trump is set to present the trophy at the final, and more breaking news from World Cup 2026.

title: AKD wanted applause for a case pertaining to a traffic offence by MP on May 25: Opposition
byline: The opposition in Parliament yesterday questioned whether President Anura Kumara Dissanayake wanted people to applaud a verdict which was given against sitting MP Chaminda Wijesiri who was charged with a traffic offence.

title: COPF, COPE battle for Committee rooms in Parliament
byline: The Committee on Public Finance (COPF) and the Committee on Public Enterprises (COPE) are in a battle over the sharing of the Committee room, it was revealed today.

title: France confirms first Ebola case
byline: France has reported its first case of Ebola during the latest outbreak after a doctor returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) tested positive.

title: Grama Niladharis withdraw from field duties from today
byline: Grama Niladharis across the country have decided to withdraw from all field duties with effect from today (June 24), according to the Grama Niladhari Trade Union Alliance.

title: Congress passes war powers measure for first time, breaking with Trump over Iran
byline: The Republican-controlled US Senate has approved a measure demanding that President Donald Trump halt the war in Iran or seek congressional approval before continuing military action.

title: Oman opens temporary Strait of Hormuz maritime corridor
byline: Oman has announced the establishment of a temporary maritime corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, following coordination with the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) and understandings reached between the United States and Iran.

title: Rupee depreciates further against US Dollar
byline: The Sri Lankan Rupee depreciated further against the US Dollar today (24), with the selling rate crossing the Rs. 340 mark, according to the latest exchange rates released by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.

title: 19-year-old girl missing from Hali Ela
byline: Police have requested public assistance to trace a 19-year-old girl reported missing from the Hali Ela area.

title: National Environment Amendment Bill unconstitutional: Opposition
byline: The Opposition in Parliament today argued that the National Environment Amendment Bill is unconstitutional as it violates the 13th Amendment.

title: Tourist arrivals cross 1.1 million mark
byline: Sri Lanka has recorded more than 1.1 million tourist arrivals between January 1 and June 21 this year, reflecting the continued recovery of the country’s tourism sector, according to the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA).

title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to have separate changing room during England series. Here’s why
byline: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s cricket journey, that has already started taking wings, will reach new heights when he gets down to action with the senior Indian men’s cricket team for the tour of Ireland and England. The 15-year-old is already a star after he finished as the top-scorer in IPL 2026 with a tally of 776 runs. Now, if he makes his senior debut against Ireland or England, he will be the youngest to do so in Indian cricket history.

title: O/L 2025 certificates to be issued only through online system
byline: The Department of Examinations has announced that certificates for the G.C.E. Ordinary Level Examination 2025 (2026) will be issued exclusively through an online system.

title: Second reading of National Environment Amendment Bill approved
byline: The second reading of the National Environment (Amendment) Bill was approved in Parliament today by a majority of 102 votes, with 113 Members of Parliament voting in favour and 10 voting against.

title: Power outages hit France as record heatwave set to peak
byline: Tens of thousands of homes are without power in western France, as temperatures are set to peak across the country on Wednesday during a record-breaking heatwave.

title: Further hearing into Gotabaya’s writ petition fixed for July 6
byline: Further hearing into the writ petition filed by former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa seeking an order preventing his arrest in connection with the ongoing investigations into the 2019 Easter Sunday terror attacks was today fixed for July 6 by the Court of Appeal.

title: World Cup History Made as Ronaldo Scores in Sixth Tournament
byline: Ronaldo makes history with a new World Cup scoring record, Donald Trump is set to present the trophy at the final, and more breaking news from World Cup 2026.

title: More than Rs. 200 billion worth of narcotic drugs recovered in 2025/26: Minister
byline: In what seemed to be a shocking disclosure, narcotic drugs worth more than Rs. 200 billion have been recovered during the period from January 1, 2025 to April 30, 2026, Minister of Public Security Ananda Wijepala revealed in Parliament.
